comparison: Additional restrictions/enforcement versus the same horizon with no further policy tightening; not a year-on-year decline or a deduction from already excluded China compute guidance.
assumption_notice: Every scenario exposure, blocked fraction and replacement fraction below is an analyst judgment, not a disclosed NVIDIA customer breakdown. Exposure means NVIDIA supplier revenue from new equipment, not server resale value or cloud rental revenue. Categories are mutually exclusive.

categories.licensed_china: Potential licensed China H200/Hopper deliveries in the counterfactual; excludes physical diversion and is not incremental China compute already in Q3 guidance.
categories.physical_diversion: New NVIDIA equipment revenue through third-party channels for physical China end use, including B200/B300 and other controlled products; excludes the offshore-service category.
categories.offshore_compute: New NVIDIA equipment procurement attributable to China-controlled offshore capacity or China end-user rentals; excludes already owned GPUs and cloud rents. Ownership structures and legal eligibility must be assessed per applicable rules.

interpretation.blocked_fraction: Fraction of counterfactual new supplier sales prevented or delayed beyond the 12-month horizon, including rule scope, licensing exceptions, actual enforcement and implementation timing.
interpretation.replacement_fraction: Share of blocked supplier revenue offset within the same horizon by independent final demand, product/supply reallocation or permitted substitutes. Re-routing to the same prohibited end user is not replacement. Existing cloud contracts are not counted again.
interpretation.scenario_probabilities: Not assigned; these are judgment scenarios, not calibrated probabilities or statistical confidence intervals.
interpretation.working_net_loss_range: USD 5-15 billion; a decision range, not an exhaustive bound.
interpretation.rounding: The base result USD 9.8 billion is communicated as approximately USD 10 billion (100亿美元).

profit_sensitivity_assumptions.excludes: One-off fines, legal costs, inventory provisions, credit losses and investment marks.
